title: 第14章 形不在，魂还在。
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

从看到她的第一眼起，司陇对她的警惕性就提到了最高。

她看似毫无生机的坐在那里，动作是散的，头发却是一丝不苟，这说明她还没有彻底瓦解，她的秩序感还有一丝留存。

形不在，魂还在。

一个在绝境中还想要维持体面的人，极其危险。

司陇没有接她的话，淡淡的说道，“孟梵？”

听到她的声音，孟梵猛地抬起头看向她，眼神中透出不可置信，细看之下似乎还带着些许不知来由的怨恨。

“居然是你？你竟然......还活着......”

她的声音渐渐低了下去。

司陇眉头皱了起来，她知道什么暗杀自己的计划？

两年时间过去了以为她早就死了，却没想到还活着。

只是最后那一丝略带怨恨的眼神是怎么回事？抓她的人是冯野，看记录上自己似乎和她没有任何交集，就算真的恨也应该是恨冯野吧。

难道是自己看错了，可孟梵没给机会，很快就把头又低了下去。

此时罗林开口，“刑犯孟梵，现提供给你减缓刑期的机会，需要你外出协助办案。”

外出？听到这两个字的孟梵，低着的头好像僵了一下，再抬起时又恢复了那死气沉沉的样子。

她目光扫过司陇的脸，最终停留在罗林的脸上，同时无力的手缓缓地指向了司陇。

“是跟她一起出去？”

“是的。”

“好......我愿意，配合。”

......

......

司陇在回办公室的路上一直在想为什么。

对于她这样的永久囚禁的刑犯，谈减刑缓冲很难勾起她愿意配合的欲望。

以为还要答应对方什么额外的条件，这件事才能够顺利地推进，没想到孟梵在确认是和她一起，就直接答应了。

她的心里很发毛，总觉得有哪里不对。

难道她知道自己不是本人？

这个想法很快被否掉，即使再熟悉的人也不可能打个照面就能看出来。

或者她有什么隐藏目的，这个目的大概率是和自己有一定的关系，不然她不会一听到是和自己一起出去就马上答应。

回到办公室胡乱扒了几口深眠准备的饭菜，也一直想着这件事，连周世通敲门喊她都没听见。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

From the first moment he saw her, Si Long was extremely wary of her.

She seemed to be sitting there lifelessly, her movements were scattered, but her hair was meticulous, which showed that she had not completely collapsed, and there was still a trace of her sense of order.

The form is gone, but the soul is still there.

A person who wants to maintain his dignity in a desperate situation is extremely dangerous.

Si Long did not answer her words and said lightly, "Meng Fan?"

Hearing her voice, Meng Fan suddenly raised his head and looked at her, with disbelief in his eyes. Upon closer inspection, he seemed to have some unknown resentment.

"It's actually you? You're actually...still alive..."

Her voice trailed off.

Si Long frowned. What plan did she know to assassinate her?

Two years later, I thought she was dead, but I didn't expect that she was still alive.

But what's with that slightly resentful look at the end?The person who arrested her was Feng Ye. From the records, it seemed that he had no interaction with her. Even if he really hated her, he should probably hate Feng Ye.

Maybe he had seen it wrong, but Meng Fan didn't give him a chance and quickly lowered his head again.

At this time, Luo Lin said, "Prisoner Meng Fan, I now offer you the opportunity to reduce your probation. You need to go out to help handle the case."

Going out?After hearing these two words, Meng Fan's lowered head seemed to freeze for a moment, and when he raised it again, it returned to its lifeless look.

Her eyes swept across Si Long's face, and finally stopped on Luo Lin's face. At the same time, her weak hand slowly pointed at Si Long.

"Going out with her?"

"Yes."

"Okay... I'm willing to cooperate."

...

...

Si Long kept thinking about why on the way back to the office.

For a prisoner like her who is permanently imprisoned, it is difficult to arouse her desire to cooperate by talking about commutation and buffering.

She thought she had to agree to some additional conditions so that the matter could proceed smoothly. Unexpectedly, Meng Fan agreed directly after confirming that he was with her.

She was very upset, and she always felt that something was wrong.

Does she know that she is not who she is?

This idea was quickly rejected. Even people who are familiar with it would not be able to tell it in person.

Or she has some hidden purpose. This purpose is most likely to have something to do with herself, otherwise she wouldn't agree immediately as soon as she heard that she was going out with him.

She returned to the office and took a few bites of the food prepared by Shen Mian. She kept thinking about this matter and didn't even hear Zhou Shitong knocking on the door and calling her.
